findings.evidence: 아마/곧/금방 조금 늦을 것 같아요 can all be natural timing/probability statements.
findings.fix: Applied bans for 아마 against 곧 and 금방.

findings.evidence: 길이 막혀서 조금 늦을/피곤할 것 같아요 are both natural.
답장이 없네요. 바쁜가/늦은가 봐요 are both plausible.
단서로 추측할/모를 수 있어요 are both natural statements about what evidence permits.
곧/아마 비가 올 것 같아요 are both natural.
비가 금방/아마 그칠지도 몰라요 are both natural.
The reading attaches 라고 directly to polite endings twice without quotation marks: 오나 봐요라고 and 몰라요라고.
findings.fix: Applied explicit quoted speech around both reported sentences and matching quotation in QA 2.

findings.evidence: QA 3 says they entered because waiting outside was uncomfortable, but the reading only states that Su-jin's situation was uncertain.
findings.fix: Applied answer correction to the stated uncertainty reason.
